text: Testing plays a key role in software development. Unit tests check small pieces of code, such as a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check that different parts of a system work together properly. Many developers also use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them catch problems early and design cleaner solutions. Good testing gives developers confidence. When they know their tests are strong, they can change code without fear of breaking things. As a result, teams can release software more safely and quickly, and users receive more reliable products.
